title: Climbing stairs
summary: Return the number of distinct ways to climb `steps` steps taking 1 or 2 steps at a time.
hints: Think about the very last move onto the top step. Where could you have been standing just before it?
You reach step n from step n - 1 or from step n - 2, so the number of ways to reach n is the sum of the ways to reach those two.
Build the answer upwards from the small cases, keeping only the last two values. Plain recursion recomputes the same steps millions of times and is far too slow for 45.
takeaway: When an answer is built from answers to smaller versions of the same question, compute the small ones first and reuse them. O(n) here, against roughly 2^n for the naive recursion.
